reserveReview.rationale: Doma Reserve Policy v2.0 (last updated 2026-10-26) states that the customer-backing reserve consists exclusively of investment-grade allocated physical gold meeting 995.0+ parts-per-thousand purity standards, with no cash, securities, receivables, or derivatives, and that aggregate fine-mass equals or exceeds circulating GDLR supply at 10 mg per token. At Ethereum block 26506037 (2026-11-27T10:47:11Z), GDLR totalSupply was 586,140.620019 GDLR (188.448585 troy oz fine gold) against 243.214439 troy oz of ERC-3643 GReserve (0xaec17f764438fecfae1cdc7c40a8658f71686570) held in VaultContract 0xa3c6c2dbeafd85096b4faba881cdb3618825643c (188.448585 troy oz locked). Confidence is capped at probable because no independent third-party physical vault audit or attestation PDF is published on doma.io, the physical vault custodian is unnamed in operative legal terms, and Reserve Policy v2.0 makes independent verification discretionary.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Doma Reserve Policy v2.0 (updated 2026-10-26) and on-chain ERC-3643 vault collateral reconciliation; no published independent physical vault audit

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Reserve Policy v2.0 states that physical gold is held in allocated form in a segregated sub-account at an unnamed professional vault operator through an unnamed custodian, with legal and beneficial title held by KSTN Capital Ltd as its own asset rather than in trust for token holders. Terms clause 5.5 keeps key service providers confidential upon request, and no vault agreement, insolvency opinion, or independent physical audit is published. Although Reserve Policy v2.0 states the reserve will not be traded, lent, or encumbered, the whitepaper qualifies non-rehypothecation with 'unless expressly agreed to by the user' and no independent assurance verifies non-encumbrance.
